input.free_text_description: This system is a messaging platform that serves Content Creator, Admin roles. It manages core business objects including models response, model. It exposes interfaces for managing deep seek local, ollama local. The system includes access control and identity verification to protect resources and manage sessions. Secondary concerns include search functionality.

user_stories.story: As a Content Creator, I want to create and manage models response records, so that I can track and organize models response data effectively.
As a Content Creator, I want to create and manage model records, so that I can track and organize model data effectively.
As a Content Creator, I want to interact with deep seek local functionality, so that I can accomplish my deep seek local-related tasks.
As a Content Creator, I want to interact with ollama local functionality, so that I can accomplish my ollama local-related tasks.
As a Content Creator, I want to access the system through a well-defined interface, so that I can perform my tasks efficiently.
